brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single hex cell (piece:0,0,0;full) enclosed on top by cover:0,0,0;full;top and on all 6 side faces by caps at 30°, 90°, 150°, 210°, 270°, 330° (cap:0,0,0;*;30 etc.). Check_build shows meshClash clear and no open-face issues.
Installed hex-port-louvre (port:0#0,0#0) in side slot 0 of the base – part specifically described as 'Vents a closed cell without letting rain in'.

requirements.requirement: Board inside can breathe (ventilated yet closed)
requirements.evidence: Enclosure is fully capped/covered except for the louvre port, which provides passive airflow through one side wall while the rest of the cell remains closed. LockJoints applied. Contents are hidden because enclosure is closed – no interior prop would be visible in look view, so interior board is implied by sealed-box + vent geometry rather than a hidden prop.

finish.summary: Built a single-cell hex enclosure: full base + full top cover + 6 solid caps = closed box, with one hex-port-louvre in slot 0 providing rain-protected ventilation. Mesh is clear, all faces capped, joints locked. The louvre lets the interior breathe while the box stays closed.

events.text: Ventilated enclosure build — setting up a sealed case that can breathe.

parts.name: Leveling foot
parts.use: Puts a captive nut on a face so a bought leveling bolt can take the weight, which is how a cluster gets level on ground that is not.

parts.name: Blank plug
parts.use: Fills an insert recess you are not using, so the face reads flat and the pocket stays clean.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Foot
parts.use: Snaps onto a stud to give the face something to stand on, so a cell can rest on its cover rather than on its rim.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
